purpose: Pre-committed candidate pool and selection rule for replacing parity prompts with unstable greedy decisions.

measurement.scope: Every generated position through each token count is measured.

selection_rule.eligibility: A candidate is eligible only when every measured logit margin is at least 0.1 at both thread counts and both token counts, and its generated token IDs agree across thread counts.
selection_rule.winner: Within each replacement pool, select the eligible candidate with the greatest minimum margin across all measured positions, thread counts, and token counts.
selection_rule.tie_breaker: If candidates have equal minimum margins, select the lexicographically smallest candidate id.
selection_rule.failure: If a pool has no eligible candidate, do not replace that prompt and do not change the margin floor or match window.

pools.required_property: A short, non-code prose continuation with match_window 3.
